original: tīrtvā pāramapāreṇa paścādyuñjīta mūrdhvani || || 6.21||
analyzed: tīrtvā pāram apāreṇa paścāt yuñjīta mūrdhvani

original: athānyatrāpyuktam dve vā va brahmaṇī abhidhyeye śabdaścāśabdaśca atha śabdenaivāśabdamāviṣkriyate atha tatra omiti śabdo'nenordhvamutkrānto'śabde nidhanameti athāhaiṣā gatiretadamṛtam atatsāyujyatvam nirvṛtatvam tathā ceti atha yathorṇanābhistantunordhvamutkrānto'vakāśaṃ labhatītyevaṃ vā va khalvāsāvabhidhyātā omityanenordhvamutkrāntaḥ svātantryaṃ
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam dve vā va brahmaṇī abhidhyeye śabdaḥ ca aśabdaḥ ca atha śabdena eva aśabdam āviṣkriyate atha tatra om iti śabda ūnena ūrdhvam utkrāntaḥ ūśabde nidhanam eti atha āha eṣā gatiḥ etat amṛtam a tad sāyujya tvam nirvṛta tvam tathā ca iti atha yathā ūrṇanābhiḥ tantunā ūrdhvam utkrāntaḥ avakāśam labhati iti evam vā va khalu asau abhidhyātā om iti anena ūrdhvam utkrāntaḥ svātantryam

original: labhate anyathā pare śabdavādinaḥ śravaṇāṅguṣṭhayogenāntarhṛdayākāśaśabdamākarṇayanti saptavidheyaṃ tasyopamā yathā nadyaḥ kiṅkiṇī kāṃsyacakrakabheka viḥkṛndikā vṛṣṭirnivāte vadatīti taṃ pṛthaglakṣaṇamatītya pare'śabde'vyakte brahmaṇyastaṃ gatāḥ tatra te'pṛthagdharmiṇo'pṛthagvivekyā yathā sampannā madhutvaṃ nānārasā ityevaṃ hyāha dve brahmaṇi
analyzed: labhate anyathā pare śabda vādinaḥ śravaṇāṅguṣṭha yogena antar hṛdaya ākāśa śabdam ākarṇayanti sapta vidheyam tasya upamā yathā nadyaḥ kiṅkiṇī kāṃsya cakraka bheka viḥ kṛndikāḥ vṛṣṭiḥ nivāte vadati iti tam pṛthak lakṣaṇam atītya pare śabdevyakte brahmaṇyaḥ tam gatāḥ tatra te pṛthak dharmiṇā upṛthak vivekyāḥ yathā sampannāḥ madhu tvam nānā rasāḥ iti evam hi āha dve brahmaṇi

original: veditavye śabdabrahma parāṃ ca yat | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || || 6.22||
analyzed: veditavye śabdabrahma parām ca yat śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahma adhigacchati

original: athānyatrāpyuktam yaḥ śabdastadomityetadakṣaram yadasyāgraṃ tacchāntamaśabdamabhayamaśokamānandaṃ tṛptaṃ sthiramacalamamṛtamacyutaṃ dhruvaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñitaṃ sarvāparatvāya tadetā upasītetyevaṃ hyāha yo'sau parāparo devā oṃkāro nāma nāmataḥ | niḥśabdaḥ śūnyabhūtastu mūrdhni sthāne tato'bhyaset || || 6.23||
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam yaḥ śabdaḥ tat om iti etat akṣaram yat asya agram tat śāntam aśabdam abhayam aśokam ānandam tṛptam sthiram acalam amṛtam acyutam dhruvam viṣṇu saṃjñitam sarva apara tvāya tat etāḥ upasītā iti evam hi āha yaḥ asau parāparaḥ devāḥ oṃkāraḥ nāma nāmataḥ niḥśabdaḥ śūnya bhūtaḥ tu mūrdhni sthāne tatas bhyaset

original: athānyatrāpyuktam dhanuḥ śarīram omityetaccharaḥ śikhāsya manaḥ tamolakṣaṇaṃ bhitvā tamo'tamāviṣṭamāgacchati athāviṣṭaṃ bhitvā'lātacakramiva sphurantamādityavarṇamūrjasvantaṃ brahma tamasaḥ paryamapaśyadyadamuṣminnāditye'tha some'gnau vidyuti vibhāti atha khalvenaṃ dṛṣṭvā'mṛtatvaṃ gacchatītyevaṃ hyāha dhyānamantaḥpare tattve lakṣyeṣu ca nidhīyate
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam dhanuḥ śarīram om iti etat śaraḥ śikhā asya manaḥ tamaḥ lakṣaṇam bhitvā tamotam āviṣṭam āgacchati atha āviṣṭam bhitvā alāta cakram iva sphurantam āditya varṇam ūrjasvantam brahma tamasaḥ paryamapaśyat yat amuṣmin āditye tha some gnau vidyuti vibhāti atha khalu enam dṛṣṭvā amṛta tvam gacchati iti evam hi āha dhyānam antar pare tattve lakṣyeṣu ca nidhīyate

original: | ato'viśeṣavijñānaṃ viśeṣamupagacchati || mānase ca vilīne tu yatsukhaṃ cātmasākṣikam | tadbrahma cāmṛtaṃ śukraṃ sā gatirloka eva saḥ || || 6.24||
analyzed: atas viśeṣa vijñānam viśeṣam upagacchati mānase ca vilīne tu yat sukham ca ātma sākṣikam tat brahma ca amṛtam śukram sā gatiḥ lokaḥ eva saḥ

original: athānyatrāpyuktam nidrevāntarhitendriyaḥ śuddhitamayā dhiyā svapna iva yaḥ paśyatīndriyabile'vivaśaḥ praṇavākhyaṃ praṇetāraṃ bhārūpaṃ vigatanidraṃ vijaraṃ vimṛtyuṃ viśokaṃ ca so'pi praṇavākhyaḥ praṇetā bhārūpaḥ vigata nidraḥ vijaraḥ vimṛtyurviśoko bhavatītyevaṃ hyāha evaṃ prāṇamathoṅkāraṃ yasmātsarvamanekadhā |
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam nidrā iva antarhita indriyaḥ śuddhi tamayā dhiyā svapne iva yaḥ paśyati indriya bile vivaśaḥ praṇava ākhyam praṇetāram bhā rūpam vigata nidram vijaram vimṛtyum viśokam ca saḥ api praṇava ākhyaḥ praṇetā bhā rūpaḥ vigata nidraḥ vijaraḥ vimṛtyuḥ viśokaḥ bhavati iti evam hi āha evam prāṇam atha uṅkāram yasmāt sarvam anekadhā

original: yunakti yuñjate vāpi yasmādyoga iti smṛtaḥ || ekatvaṃ prāṇamanasorindriyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | sarvabhāvaparityāgo yoga ityabhidhīyate || || 6.25||
analyzed: yunakti yuñjate vā api yasmāt yogaḥ iti smṛtaḥ eka tvam prāṇa manasoḥ indriyāṇām tathā eva ca sarva bhāva parityāgaḥ yogaḥ iti abhidhīyate

original: athānyatrāpyuktam yathā vāpsu cāriṇaḥ śākunikaḥ sūtrayantreṇoddhṛtyodare'gnau juhotyevaṃ vā va khalvimānprāṇānomityanenoddhṛtyānāmaye'gnau juhoti atastaptorvivaso'tha yathā taptorvi sārpistṛṇakāṣṭhasaṃsparśe nojjvalatītyevaṃ vā va khalvasāvaprāṇākhyaḥ prāṇasaṃsparśenojjvalati atha yadujjvalatyetadbrahmaṇo rūpaṃ caitadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam yathā vā apsu cāriṇaḥ śākunikaḥ sūtrayantreṇa uddhṛtya udare ignau juhoti evam vā vai khalu imān prāṇān om iti anena uddhṛtya anāmaye ignau juhoti atas tapta urvi vasā utha yathā tapta urvi sārpiḥ tṛṇa kāṣṭha saṃsparśe na ujjvalati iti evam vā vai khalu asau aprāṇa ākhyaḥ prāṇa saṃsparśena ujjvalati atha yat ujjvalati etat brahmaṇaḥ rūpam ca etat viṣṇoḥ paramam padam

original: caitadrudrasya rudratvametattadaparimitadhā cātmānaṃ vibhajya pūrayatīmāṃ lokānityevaṃ hyāha vahneśca yadvatkhalu visphuliṅgāḥ sūryānmayūkhāśca tathaiva tasya prāṇādayo vai punareva tasmād abhyuccarantīha yathākrameṇa || || 6.26||
analyzed: ca etat rudrasya rudra tvam etat tat aparimitadhā ca ātmānam vibhajya pūrayati imām lokān iti evam hi āha vahneḥ ca yadvat khalu visphuliṅgāḥ sūryāt mayūkhāḥ ca tathā eva tasya prāṇa ādayaḥ vai punar eva tasmāt abhyuccaranti iha yathākrameṇa

original: athānyatrāpyuktam brahmaṇo vā vaitattejaḥ parasyāmṛtasyāśarīrasya yaccharīrasyauṣṇyamasyaitad ghṛtamathāviḥ san nabhasi nihitaṃ vaitadekāgreṇaivamantarhṛdayākāśaṃ vinudanti yattasya jyotiriva sampadyatīti atastadbhāvam acireṇaiti bhūmāvayaspiṇḍaṃ nihitaṃ yathā'cireṇaiti bhūmitvam mṛdvatsaṃsthamayaspiṇḍaṃ yathāgnyayaskārādayo nābhibhavanti
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam brahmaṇaḥ vā vā etat tejaḥ parasya amṛtasya aśarīrasya yat śarīrasya auṣṇyam asya etat ghṛtam atha āvis san nabhasi nihitam vā etat ekāgreṇa evam antar hṛdaya ākāśam vinudanti yat tasya jyotiḥ iva sampadyati iti atas tad bhāvam acireṇa eti bhūmau ayaḥ piṇḍam nihitam yathā acireṇa eti bhūmi tvam mṛd vat saṃstham ayaḥ piṇḍam yathā agni ayaskāra ādayaḥ na abhibhavanti

original: praṇaśyati cittaṃ tathāśrayeṇa sahaivamityevaṃ hyāha hṛdyākāśamayaṃ kośamānandaṃ paramālayam | svaṃ yogaśca tato'smākaṃ tejaścaivāgnisūryayoḥ || || 6.27||
analyzed: praṇaśyati cittam tathā āśrayeṇa saha evam iti evam hi āha hṛdi ākāśa mayam kośam ānandam parama ālayam svam yogaḥ ca tatas usmākam tejaḥ ca eva agni sūryayoḥ

original: athānyatrāpyuktam
analyzed: atha anyatra api uktam

original: bhūtendriyārthānatikramya tataḥ pravrajyājyaṃ dhṛtidaṇḍaṃ dhanurgṛhītvā'nabhimānamayena caiveṣuṇā taṃ brahma dvārapāraṃ nihatyādyaṃ saṃmohamaulī tṛṣṇerṣyākuṇḍalī tandrīrāghavetryabhimānādhyakṣaḥ krodhajyaṃ pralobhadaṇḍaṃ dhanurgṛhītvecchāmayena caiveṣuṇemāni khalu bhūtāni hanti taṃ hatvoṃkāraplavenāntarhṛdayākāśasya pāraṃ tīrtvāvirbhūte antarākāśe
analyzed: bhūta indriya arthān atikramya tatas pravrajyā ājyam dhṛti daṇḍam dhanuḥ gṛhītvā anabhimāna mayena ca eva iṣuṇā tam brahma dvāra pāram nihatya ādyam saṃmoha maulī tṛṣṇā īrṣyā kuṇḍalī tandrī rāghava itrī abhimāna adhyakṣaḥ krodha jyam pralobha daṇḍam dhanuḥ gṛhītvā icchā mayena ca eva iṣuṇā imāni khalu bhūtāni hanti tam hatvā oṃkāra plavena antar hṛdaya ākāśasya pāram tīrtvā āvirbhūte antar ākāśe

original: śanakairavaṭaivāvaṭakṛddhātukāmaḥ saṃviśatyevaṃ brahmaśālāṃ viśet tataścaturjālaṃ brahmakośaṃ praṇudet gurvāgameneti
analyzed: śanakais avaṭa eva avaṭa kṛt dhātu kāmaḥ saṃviśati evam brahmaśālām viśet tatas catur jālam brahmakośam praṇudet guru āgamena iti

original: ataḥ śuddhaḥ pūtaḥ śūnyaḥ śānto'prāṇo nirātmā'nanto'kṣayyaḥ sthiraḥ śāśvato'jaḥ svatantraḥ sve mahimni tiṣṭhati ataḥ sve mahimni tiṣṭhamānam dṛṣṭvā'vṛttacakramiva sañcāracakramālokayati ityevaṃ hyāha
analyzed: atas śuddhaḥ pūtaḥ śūnyaḥ śānta uprāṇaḥ nirātmā ananta ukṣayyaḥ sthiraḥ śāśvata ojaḥ svatantraḥ sve mahimni tiṣṭhati atas sve mahimni tiṣṭhamānam dṛṣṭvā āvṛtta cakram iva sañcāra cakram ālokayati iti evam hi āha

original: ṣaḍbhirmāsaistu yuktasya nityamuktasya dehinaḥ
analyzed: ṣaḍbhiḥ māsaiḥ tu yuktasya nitya muktasya dehinaḥ

original: anantaḥ paramo guhyaḥ samyagyogaḥ pravartate ||
analyzed: anantaḥ paramaḥ guhyaḥ samyak yogaḥ pravartate

original: rajastamobhyāṃ viddhasya susamiddhasya dehinaḥ
analyzed: rajaḥ tamobhyām viddhasya su samiddhasya dehinaḥ

original: putradārakuṭumbeṣu saktasya na kadācana || || 6.28||
analyzed: putra dāra kuṭumbeṣu saktasya na kadācana

original: evamuktvā'ntarhṛdayaḥ śakāyanyastasmai namaskṛtvā'nayā brahmavidyayā rājan brahmaṇaḥ panthānamārūḍhāḥ putrāḥ prajāpateriti santoṣaṃ dvandvatitikṣāṃ śāntatvaṃ yogābhyāsādavāpnotīti etadguhyatamaṃ nāputrāya nāśiṣyāya nāśāntāya kīrtayediti ananyabhaktāya sarvaguṇasampannāya dadyāt || || 6.29||
analyzed: evam uktvā antar hṛdayaḥ śakāyanyaḥ tasmai namaskṛtvā anayā brahma vidyayā rājan brahmaṇaḥ panthānam ārūḍhāḥ putrāḥ prajāpateḥ iti santoṣam dvandva titikṣām śānta tvam yoga abhyāsāt avāpnoti iti etat guhyatamam na a putrāya na a śiṣyāya na a śāntāya kīrtayet iti ananya bhaktāya sarva guṇa sampannāya dadyāt

original: oṃ śucau deśe śuciḥ sattvasthaḥ sadadhīyānaḥ sadvādī saddhyāyī sadyājī syāditi | ataḥ sadbrahmaṇi satyabhilāṣiṇi nirvṛttyo'nastatphalacchinnapāśo nirāśaḥ pareṣvātmavadvigatabhayo niṣkāmo'kṣayyamaparimitaṃ sukhamākramya tiṣṭhati | paramaṃ vai śevadheriva parasyoddharaṇaṃ yanniṣkāmatvam |
analyzed: om śucau deśe śuciḥ sattva sthaḥ sat adhīyānaḥ sat vādī sat dhyāyī sat yājī syāt iti atas sat brahmaṇi sati abhilāṣiṇi nirvṛttyā ūnaḥ tad phala chinna pāśaḥ nirāśaḥ pareṣu ātma vat vigata bhayaḥ niṣkāmaḥ ukṣayyam aparimitam sukham ākramya tiṣṭhati paramam vai śevadheḥ iva parasya uddharaṇam yat niṣkāma tvam

original: sa hi sarvakāmamayaḥ puruṣo'dhyavasāyasaṅkalpābhimānaliṅgo baddaḥ | atastadviparīto muktaḥ | atraika āhurguṇaḥ prakṛtibhedavaśāsadhyavasāyātmabandhamupāgato|
analyzed: sa hi sarva kāma mayaḥ atas tad viparītaḥ muktaḥ atra eke āhuḥ guṇaḥ

original: adhyavasāyasya doṣakṣayāddhi mokṣaḥ manasā hyeva paśyati manasā śṛṇoti kāmaḥ saṅkalpo vicikitsā śraddhā'śraddhā dhṛtiradhṛtirhrīrdhīrbhīrityetatsarvaṃ mana eva guṇaughairuhyamānaḥ kaluṣīkṛtaścāsthiraścalo lupyamānaḥ saspṛho vyagraścābhimānitvaṃ prayāta iti ahaṃ so mamedamityevaṃ manyamāno nibadhnātyātmanātmānaṃ jāleneva khecaraḥ |
analyzed: adhyavasāyasya doṣa kṣayāt hi mokṣaḥ manasā hi eva paśyati manasā śṛṇoti kāmaḥ saṅkalpaḥ vicikitsā śraddhā aśraddhā dhṛtiḥ adhṛtiḥ hrīḥ dhīḥ bhīḥ iti etat sarvam manaḥ eva guṇa oghaiḥ uhyamānaḥ kaluṣīkṛtaḥ ca asthiraḥ calaḥ lupyamānaḥ sa spṛhaḥ vyagraḥ ca abhimāni tvam prayātaḥ iti aham saḥ mama idam iti evam manyamānaḥ nibadhnāti ātmanā ātmānam jālena iva khecaraḥ

original: ataḥ puruṣo'dhyāvasāyasaṅkalpābimānaliṅgo baddaḥ atastadviparīto muktaḥ tasmānniradhyavasāyo niḥsaṅkalpo nirabhimānastiṣṭhet etanmokṣalakṣaṇam eṣātra brahmapadavī eṣo'tra dvāravivaro'nenāsya tamasaḥ pāraṃ gamiṣyati | atra hi sarve kāmāḥ samāhitā ityatrodāharanti yadā pañcāvatiṣṭhante jñānāni manasā saha |
analyzed: atas atas atas tad viparītaḥ muktaḥ tasmāt niradhyavasāyaḥ niḥsaṅkalpaḥ nirabhimānaḥ tiṣṭhet etat mokṣa lakṣaṇam eṣā atra brahma padavī eṣā utra dvāra vivarā ūnena asya tamasaḥ pāram gamiṣyati atra hi sarve kāmāḥ samāhitāḥ iti atra udāharanti yadā pañca avatiṣṭhante jñānāni manasā saha

original: buddhiśa na viceṣṭate tāmāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim || etaduktvāntarhṛdayaḥ śākāyanyastasmai namaskṛtvā yathāvadupacārī kṛtakṛtyo maruduttarāyaṇaṃ gato na hyatrodvartmanā gatiḥ eṣo'tra brahmapathaḥ sauraṃ sdvāraṃ bhittvorddhvena vinirgatā ityatrodāharanti anantā raśmayastasya dīpavadyaḥ sthito hṛdi | sitāsitāḥ kadrunīlāḥ kapilā mṛdulohitāḥ ||
analyzed: na viceṣṭate tām āhuḥ paramām gatim etat uktvā antar hṛdayaḥ śākāyanyaḥ tasmai namaskṛtvā yathāvat upacārī kṛtakṛtyaḥ marut uttarāyaṇam gataḥ na hi atra udvartmanā gatiḥ eṣaḥ utra brahma pathaḥ sauram sdvāram bhittvā ūrddhvena vinirgatāḥ iti atra udāharanti anantāḥ raśmayaḥ tasya dīpa vat yaḥ sthitaḥ hṛdi sita asitāḥ kadru nīlāḥ kapilāḥ mṛdu lohitāḥ

original: ūrdhvamekaḥ sthitasteṣāṃ yo bhibhitvā sūryamaṇḍalam | brahmalokamatikramya tena yānti parāṃ gatim || yadasyānyadraśmiśatamūrdhvameva vyavasthitam | tena devanikāyānāṃ svadhāmāni prapadyate || ye naikarūpāścādhastādraśmayo'sya mṛduprabhāḥ | iha karmopabhogāya taiḥ saṃsarati so'vaṣaḥ | tasmātsargasvargāpavargaheturbhagavānasāvāditya iti || || 6.30||
analyzed: ūrdhvam ekaḥ sthitaḥ teṣām yaḥ bhibhitvā sūrya maṇḍalam brahma lokam atikramya tena yānti parām gatim yat asya anyat raśmi śatam ūrdhvam eva vyavasthitam tena devanikāyānām sva dhāmāni prapadyate ye na ekarūpāḥ ca adhastāt raśmayaḥ sya mṛdu prabhāḥ iha karma upabhogāya taiḥ saṃsarati saḥ u vaṣaḥ tasmāt sarga svarga apavarga hetuḥ bhagavān asau ādityaḥ iti
